healthscore_type.description:
Controls the entity type and grouping granularity of health score results:
* **Site** - aggregates health score per site. Each result row represents one site.
* **Circuit** - aggregates health score per WAN circuit (path) within each site. Each result row represents one WAN path identified by its WAN path ID.
* **AnynetLink** - aggregates health score per Anynet link within each circuit. An AnyNet link (also known as a Secure Fabric link) is an automated, zero-touch VPN tunnel established by the Prisma SD-WAN controller to connect branch offices and data centers. Each result row represents one overlay VPN tunnel.

aggregation.description:
Time-series aggregation function applied to health scores within the query window. Determines how per-minute health score samples are collapsed into a single score per entity:
* `min` - uses the lowest (worst) health score observed in the time window.
* `max` - uses the highest (best) health score observed in the time window.
* `avg` - uses the mean health score across the time window.

clients.description: Optional list of child tenant IDs to scope the results. If omitted, results include all client tenants under the MSP tenant.

start_time.description: Query start time in ISO 8601 UTC format (e.g., 2024-01-15T00:00:00Z). Optional, but must be provided together with `end_time`. If either `start_time` or `end_time` is omitted, the query window defaults to the most recent 5 minutes. When both fields are provided, the window may not exceed 3 months.

end_time.description: Query end time in ISO 8601 UTC format (e.g., 2024-01-15T01:00:00Z). Optional, but must be provided together with `start_time`. If either `end_time` or `start_time` is omitted, the query window defaults to the most recent 5 minutes. When both fields are provided, the window may not exceed 3 months.

MonitorMetricsFilterV2N6.description:
Filter criteria for metrics queries. Requirements vary by metric type.

## Cross-Field Dependencies
These dependencies are enforced at runtime:
- `path` requires `site`
- `waninterface` requires `site`
- `element` requires `site`
- `anynet_link` requires `waninterface`

## Mutual Exclusions
- Cannot specify both `path` and `path_type`

site.description:
Site IDs to filter by.

**Required for (MUST_HAVE_SITE):** TCPConcurrentFlows, UDPConcurrentFlows, ConcurrentFlowsAlt, TCPConcurrentFlowsAlt, UDPConcurrentFlowsAlt, OtherConcurrentFlowsAlt, AppTransactionSLA, PathCapacity, PcmJitter, PcmLatency, PcmPacketLoss, LqmLatency, LqmPacketLoss, LqmJitter, LqmMos, LqmLinkHealthy, LqmLinkHealth, LqmLatencyThreshold, LqmPacketLossThreshold, LqmJitterThreshold, AppUnreachable, AppRoundTripTime, AppServerResponseTime, AppNormalizedNetworkTransferTime, AppUDPTransactionResponseTime, AppPathGoodPut, AppPerfUDPAudioBandwidth, AppPerfUDPAudioPacketLoss, AppPerfUDPAudioJitter, AppPerfUDPVideoBandwidth, AppPerfUDPVideoPacketLoss, AppPerfUDPVideoJitter, CPUUsage, MemoryUsage, DiskUsage, Healthscore

**Single value required for (MUST_HAVE_SINGLE_SITE):** PathCapacity, PcmJitter, PcmLatency, PcmPacketLoss, LqmLatency, LqmPacketLoss, LqmJitter, LqmMos, LqmLinkHealthy, LqmLinkHealth, LqmLatencyThreshold, LqmPacketLossThreshold, LqmJitterThreshold, AppUnreachable, AppRoundTripTime, AppServerResponseTime, AppNormalizedNetworkTransferTime, AppUDPTransactionResponseTime, AppPathGoodPut, AppPerfUDPAudioBandwidth, AppPerfUDPAudioPacketLoss, AppPerfUDPAudioJitter, AppPerfUDPVideoBandwidth, AppPerfUDPVideoPacketLoss, AppPerfUDPVideoJitter, AppSiteHealth, Healthscore

You can look up valid Site IDs using the following endpoint

[`Get Site details of a tenant`](https://pan.dev/sdwan/api/legacy/eir-sitev-4-n-13-getallsites-v-4-13/)

element.description:
List of Element IDs to filter results. You can look up valid Element IDs using the following endpoint

[`Get Elements of a tenant`](https://pan.dev/sdwan/api/legacy/eir-elementv-3-n-2-getelements-v-3-2/) 

  
**Dependency:** Requires `site` filter to be present.

app.description:
Application IDs to filter by.

**Required for (MUST_HAVE_APP):** AppAudioMos, AppVideoMos, AppUnreachable, AppRoundTripTime, AppServerResponseTime, AppNormalizedNetworkTransferTime, AppUDPTransactionResponseTime, AppPathGoodPut, AppPerfUDPAudioBandwidth, AppPerfUDPAudioPacketLoss, AppPerfUDPAudioJitter, AppPerfUDPVideoBandwidth, AppPerfUDPVideoPacketLoss, AppPerfUDPVideoJitter

**Single value required for (MUST_HAVE_SINGLE_APP):** AppUnreachable, AppRoundTripTime, AppServerResponseTime, AppNormalizedNetworkTransferTime, AppUDPTransactionResponseTime, AppPathGoodPut, AppPerfUDPAudioBandwidth, AppPerfUDPAudioPacketLoss, AppPerfUDPAudioJitter, AppPerfUDPVideoBandwidth, AppPerfUDPVideoPacketLoss, AppPerfUDPVideoJitter, AppAudioMos, AppSiteHealth

**Required with site (MUST_HAVE_SITE_APP):** AppConcurrentSessions, AppSiteHealth

path.description:
Path IDs to filter by.

**Dependency:** Requires `site` filter to be present.

**Mutual exclusion:** Cannot be used together with `path_type`.

**Required for (MUST_HAVE_PATH_ID):** PathCapacity, PcmJitter, PcmLatency, PcmPacketLoss, LqmLatency, LqmPacketLoss, LqmJitter, LqmMos, LqmLinkHealthy, LqmLinkHealth, LqmLatencyThreshold, LqmPacketLossThreshold, LqmJitterThreshold

**Single value required for (MUST_HAVE_SINGLE_PATH_ID):** PathCapacity, PcmJitter, PcmLatency, PcmPacketLoss, LqmLatency, LqmPacketLoss, LqmJitter, LqmMos, LqmLinkHealthy, LqmLinkHealth, LqmLatencyThreshold, LqmPacketLossThreshold, LqmJitterThreshold

**XOR with waninterface:** Provide either `path` OR `waninterface`, not both.

**Forbidden for (NO_PATH_FILTER):** AppConcurrentSessions

path_type.description:
Path types to filter by.

**Mutual exclusion:** Cannot be used together with `path`.

waninterface.description:
WAN Interface IDs to filter by.

**Dependency:** Requires `site` filter to be present.

**Forbidden for (NO_WANINTERFACE_FILTER):** PathCapacity, PcmJitter, PcmLatency, PcmPacketLoss

**Single value required for (MUST_HAVE_SINGLE_PATH_ID):** PathCapacity, PcmJitter, PcmLatency, PcmPacketLoss, LqmLatency, LqmPacketLoss, LqmJitter, LqmMos, LqmLinkHealthy, LqmLinkHealth, LqmLatencyThreshold, LqmPacketLossThreshold, LqmJitterThreshold

**XOR with path:** Provide either `path` OR `waninterface`, not both.

You can look up valid waninterface IDs using the following endpoint

[`Get WAN interface details`](https://pan.dev/sdwan/api/legacy/eir-waninterfacev-2-n-10-getinterfaces-v-2-10/)

anynet_link.description:
Anynet Link IDs to filter by.

**Dependency:** Requires `waninterface` filter to be present.

You can look up valid anynet_link IDs using the following endpoint

[`Get Anynet details`](https://pan.dev/sdwan/api/legacy/rhe-anynetlinkv-4-queryanynetlinks-v-4-0/)

remote_site.description:
Remote Site IDs to filter by.

**Single value required for (MUST_HAVE_SINGLE_REMOTE_SITE):** LqmLatency, LqmPacketLoss, LqmJitter, LqmMos, LqmLinkHealthy, LqmLinkHealth, LqmLatencyThreshold, LqmPacketLossThreshold, LqmJitterThreshold

direction.description:
Traffic direction to filter by.

**Required for (MUST_HAVE_DIRECTION):** PathCapacity, PcmJitter, PcmPacketLoss, LqmPacketLoss, LqmJitter, LqmMos, AppAudioMos, AppVideoMos, AppPerfUDPAudioPacketLoss, AppPerfUDPAudioJitter, AppPerfUDPVideoPacketLoss, AppPerfUDPVideoJitter
(unless `view.individual=direction` is set)

**Optional for (DIRECTION_AWARE_LISTS):** BandwidthUsage, BandwidthUsageTCP, BandwidthUsageUDP, TrafficVolume, TrafficVolumeTCP, TrafficVolumeUDP, PathCapacity, LqmPacketLoss, LqmJitter, LqmPacketLossThreshold, LqmJitterThreshold, LqmMos, AppPerfUDPAudioBandwidth, AppPerfUDPAudioPacketLoss, AppPerfUDPAudioJitter, AppPerfUDPVideoBandwidth, AppPerfUDPVideoPacketLoss, AppPerfUDPVideoJitter, AppAudioMos, AppVideoMos, InterfaceBandwidthUsage, InterfaceDroppedPackets, InterfaceErrors, InterfaceFifoErrors, CellularTrafficVolume, CellularBandwidthUsage, CellularPacketDrops, CellularPacketErrors, CellularPacketOverflows

**Mutual exclusion:** Cannot be used together with `view.individual=direction`

topn_basis.description:
Ranking metric for top N results:
* `interface_ingress_bytes` - Total bytes received on the interface
* `interface_egress_bytes` - Total bytes transmitted on the interface
* `interface_ingress_packets` - Total packets received on the interface
* `interface_egress_packets` - Total packets transmitted on the interface
* `interface_ingress_dropped_packets` - Total inbound packets dropped on the interface
* `interface_egress_dropped_packets` - Total outbound packets dropped on the interface
* `interface_ingress_errors` - Total inbound errors on the interface
* `interface_egress_errors` - Total outbound errors on the interface
* `interface_poe_power_consumption` - PoE power consumed by the interface port
* `interface_poe_power_denied_counter` - Number of times PoE power was denied on the interface port
* `interface_poe_overload_counter` - Number of PoE overload events on the interface port
* `interface_lldp_tx_total_frames` - Total LLDP frames transmitted on the interface
* `interface_lldp_rx_total_frames` - Total LLDP frames received on the interface
* `interface_lldp_tx_failed_frames` - Total LLDP frames that failed to transmit on the interface

top_n.description: Defines the ranking dimension and result limit. The `type` field (required) controls which entity type is ranked; `limit` (optional) caps the number of results returned.

type.description:
Entity type to rank in the Top N results:
* `interface` - ranks individual interfaces across the selected sites.
* `element` - aggregates the metric across all interfaces per element (device) and ranks elements.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Range: 1-10. Default: 10.

filter.description: Query scope filter. `site` is required. If `element` is provided, `site` must also be provided.

site.description:
List of site IDs to filter by. Required; at least one item must be provided. Maximum 10 items. Each ID is a numeric string.

[`Get sites`](https://pan.dev/sdwan/api/legacy/eir-sitev-4-n-13-getallsites-v-4-13/)

element.description:
List of element (device) IDs to further scope the query within the specified sites. Optional. Maximum 10 items. If provided, `filter.site` must also be provided.

[`Get elements`](https://pan.dev/sdwan/api/legacy/eir-elementv-3-n-2-getelements-v-3-2/)

start_time.description: Query start time in ISO 8601 UTC format (e.g., 2024-01-15T00:00:00Z). Must not be a future time. Maximum lookback is 7 days for standard tenants or 3 months for tenants with the extended data retention (DVR) license. If omitted, defaults to 7 days ago (or 3 months ago with DVR license).

end_time.description: Query end time in ISO 8601 UTC format (e.g., 2024-01-15T01:00:00Z). If omitted, defaults to the current server time. The time window between `start_time` and `end_time` must not exceed 3 months.

post.description:
SD-WAN Northbound Statistics API for querying monitoring metrics.

This API allows you to query various network metrics like bandwidth usage,
latency, packet loss, and application performance data.

Filter Requirements by Metric -

Different metrics have different filter requirements. See each metric's
description for specific requirements. Common patterns:

| Metric Category | Required Filters | Notes |
|-----------------|------------------|-------|
| BandwidthUsage, TrafficVolume, FlowCounts | None | All filters optional |
| LQM metrics (Latency, PacketLoss, Jitter, Mos) | site, path OR waninterface | Single values only |
| PathCapacity | site, path, direction | Cannot use waninterface |
| App metrics (AudioMos, VideoMos) | site, app, direction | Single values only |
| ConcurrentFlows | site | Only one filter can have multiple values |

Cross-Field Dependencies -

- `path` requires `site` to be present
- `waninterface` requires `site` to be present
- `element` requires `site` to be present
- `anynet_link` requires `waninterface` to be present

Mutual Exclusions -

- `path` and `path_type` cannot be used together
- `filter.direction` and `view.individual=direction` cannot be used together

Case Sensitivity -

Metric names are **case-sensitive**. For example, use `ApplicationHealthscore`
(lowercase 's'), not `ApplicationHealthScore`.

post.description:
Get cellular metrics like SNR, Cellular bandwidth usage etc. External API used for stats queries.
Below are the tenet for queries
* interval is required
* start_time, end_time and max_datapoints are optional with the following restrictions, at least one of them needs to be specified.
  all the three can not be specified, as the result is ambiguous.
Note
* Start time, if not specified, default to epoch.
* End time, if not specified, default to now.
* Limit, if not specified, defaults to None..
* Start and end times need to be specified in ISO8601 UTC format.
* Metrics need to specified according to 2.1 specifications. Invalid metrics will be ignored and the result will not include them.
* Filters need to be specified according to the specifications.

info.title: Prisma SD-WAN APIs
info.description: These APIs are used for managing Prisma SD-WAN configuration

tags.name: ADEM
tags.description: List of APIs used to retrieve the Autonomous DEM status in Prisma SD-WAN.

tags.name: Applications
tags.description: List of APIs used to manage an application definition specific query, overrides, and version information.

tags.name: Auditlogs
tags.description: List of APIs used to retrieve and query audit logs for tenant activities.

tags.name: Bulk Operations
tags.description: List of APIs used to manage the bulk configuations query and metrics.

tags.name: Cellular
tags.description: List of APIs used to manage the cellular device, services, APN profiles, and modules.

tags.name: Certificates
tags.description: List of APIs used to manage certificates and external CA configurations.

tags.name: DHCP
tags.description: List of APIs used to manage the DHCP servers.

tags.name: DNS Services
tags.description: List of APIs used to manage the DNS services.

tags.name: Device Configuration
tags.description: List of APIs used to manage your device software to upgrade, retrieve available software images, and upgrade status information.

tags.name: Device Switch Configuration
tags.description: List of APIs used to manage device switch configurations including RADIUS, MSTP, VLAN, and interface authentication.

tags.name: Event Policy
tags.description: List of APIs used to manage the event policy rules that inlcude managing of event correlation policy rules and sets and querying of the rules and sets.

tags.name: Events
tags.description: List of APIs used to retrieve and query correlation events for sites, elements, interfaces, and WAN links.

tags.name: IPFIX
tags.description: List of APIs used to manage the IPFIX services.

tags.name: IoT
tags.description: List of APIs used to manage IoT device configurations, profiles, mappings, and discovery.

tags.name: Metrics
tags.description: List of APIs used to retrieve SDWAN metrics such as badnwidth utilization, TCP transaction, application health, application performance, LQM, flows, interface & system metrics.

tags.name: Monitoring
tags.description: List of APIs used to retrieve monitoring insights and insights list.

tags.name: Multicast
tags.description: List of APIs used to manage multicast specific configurations.

tags.name: NAT Policy
tags.description: List of APIs used to manage the NAT policy rules.

tags.name: NTP
tags.description: List of APIs used to manage NTP.

tags.name: Network Constructs
tags.description: List of APIs used to manage Network constructs in Prisma SD-WAN like WAN Networks, LAN Networks, Circuit labels, and Network Contexts. All these are used to define a circuit and create policies.

tags.name: OSPF
tags.description: List of APIs used to manage OSPF routing configurations.

tags.name: Path Policy
tags.description: List of APIs used to manage the network path policy rules.

tags.name: Path Policy Original
tags.description: List of APIs used to manage the original path policies rules.

tags.name: Performance Management
tags.description: List of APIs used to manage performance management policy rules and rule sets.

tags.name: Performance Policy
tags.description: List of APIs used to manage performance management policy sets, stacks, threshold profiles, and probe configurations.

tags.name: Prisma Access Configs
tags.description: List of APIs used to manage Prisma Access configurations, networks, and connections.

tags.name: QOS Policy
tags.description: List of APIs used to manage the QoS policies.

tags.name: Reports
tags.description: List of APIs used to generate and retrieve reports.

tags.name: Routing
tags.description: List of APIs used to configure all routing contructs like, BGP configs, static routes, AS paths, and community lists.

tags.name: SASE Fabric
tags.description: List of APIs used to manage SASE fabric connections and configurations.

tags.name: SD-WAN Applications
tags.description: List of APIs used to manage SD-WAN application configurations and status.

tags.name: SNMP
tags.description: List of APIs used to manage SNMP.

tags.name: Security Policy
tags.description: List of APIs used to manage your security policy rules that include security zones, element security  zones, site security zones, global prefix filters, local prefix filters, security policy rule order, security policy rules, security policy sets, prefix filters, tenant filters, next generation firewall security policy prefixes, rules, policy sets, and policy set stacks.

tags.name: Security Profiles
tags.description: List of APIs used to manage security profiles including DNS security, URL filtering, spyware, and vulnerability profiles.

tags.name: Service & DC Groups
tags.description: List of APIs used to manage the DC groups, service endpoints and service mappings. It is used to classify sites (Data Centers) into DC groups and external service groups.

tags.name: Services
tags.description: List of APIs used to manage the Syslog servers.

tags.name: Site Configuration
tags.description: List of APIs used to manage your site specific configuration attributes, and HA configuration for both branch and data center sites.

tags.name: Site Snapshots
tags.description: List of APIs used to manage site configuration snapshots.

tags.name: Site Templates
tags.description: List of APIs used to manage site templates for bulk configurations.

tags.name: Software Management
tags.description: List of APIs used to manage your device software to upgrade, retrieve available software images, and upgrade status information.

tags.name: System Administration
tags.description: List of APIs used to manage the operators, IDPs, users, base roles, base permissions,  password change, sign up, client roles, licenses, and incident management.

tags.name: Topology
tags.description: List of APIs used to manage the network topology, WAN Overlays, VPN Links, and Secure Fabric Links.

tags.name: User ID
tags.description: List of APIs used to manage directory users, user groups, and user identity agents.
